admission.client: client dispatch including connect to native TURN_STARTED acknowledgement; not pure server setup time
prefill.wall: server-authored complete newly executed prefill wall time
decode.post-first.committed: committed tokens after first / elapsed decode wall after first
prefill.uncached: newly committed uncached input positions / complete prefill wall
ttft.server: turn start to first committed model-token callback
ttft.client-visible: client dispatch including connect to first nonempty final/reasoning content
reasoning.first.server: server turn start to first source-classified reasoning token
reasoning.first.client: client dispatch including connect to first nonempty reasoning fragment
final.first.server: server turn start to first source-classified final token
final.first.client: client dispatch including connect to first nonempty final fragment
reasoning.phase-rate: source-classified reasoning tokens / server phase from prefill completion to reasoning boundary or decode end; not post-first sustained rate
final.phase-rate: source-classified final tokens / server phase from reasoning boundary or prefill completion to decode end; not post-first sustained rate
request.client-complete: client dispatch including connect through terminal response
memory.rss-peak: observed process peak RSS; not device residency
nll.teacher-forced: mean negative log probability of the same teacher-forced continuation
perplexity: exp(mean teacher-forced NLL) on exact matching positions
kl.reference-candidate: mean full-vocabulary KL(reference || candidate) on the same contexts
probability-delta.rms: RMS candidate minus reference probability over full vocabulary and positions
same-top-token: fraction of identical full-vocabulary argmax tokens, same contexts
greedy-prefix: matching continuation prefix under the declared exact comparison policy
